hero.lead: Sale or rent. You complete 6 simple steps, we check it, and buyers contact you directly.
hero.seeSteps: See what the steps look like
hero.startSignedOut: Sign in and start your listing
hero.accountHint: You need a free account. Don't have one? Create it in 1 minute, on the same page.

card.title: 3-room apartment, Complex
card.pinTitle: The pin is on the building
card.pinText: The public only sees the area

path.intro: The account is free. This way only you can edit or withdraw the listing, and messages reach you.

prepare.title: Read the steps and get everything ready
prepare.text: The photos, the floor area from your documents and the price. This page shows you everything that follows.

account.title: Sign in or create an account
account.text: Email and password, it takes a minute.

publish.title: You submit, we check, it goes live
publish.text: Within 24 hours your listing is in search and on the map. If something is not right, we tell you why.

path.note: You lose nothing you fill in: after you sign in, we take you straight to the form.

steps.intro: Tap a step to see what you fill in and what the form looks like.

autosave.title: Autosave
autosave.text: pick up any time where you left off

type.title: Sale or rent
type.text: Choose the type and set the price. For rent, the monthly amount.
type.tip: We show you the area average before you publish.

photos.title: Photos
photos.text: Upload 5–15 photos and choose the cover.
points: Reorder by dragging or with the arrows
No people, documents or personal data
photos.tip: The first photo decides whether someone opens the listing.

description.title: Title and description
description.text: A few honest lines about the home.
points: Type, rooms and area in the title
description.tip: No superlatives. Buyers look for facts.

details.title: Details
details.text: The figures that search filters use.
points: Floor out of the building's floors
details.tip: Take the area from your documents, not an estimate.

location.title: Address and pin
location.text: The exact address stays with us. The public only sees the area.
points: The pin on the right building
A public circle of about 300 m
location.tip: A correct pin gives correct distances on the listing.

contact.title: Contact and publishing
contact.text: Leave a phone number and submit. This is where you need an account.
points: Your phone number shows only on request
Messages arrive by email and in your account
contact.tip: We check the listing within 24 hours.

preview.summary: Preview of the form for the "{{step}}" step.

preview.mapNote: The circle is what the public sees. Only you see the pin.
preview.submitNote: Requires an account · reviewed within 24 h

price.title: Price or rent
price.text: We compare it with the area

sent.title: Submitted for publishing
sent.text: You get a confirmation by email

review.title: We check within 24 h
review.text: Photos, a plausible price, personal data

published.title: Published
published.text: In search and on the map

messages.title: You receive messages
messages.text: By email and in your account, under Requests

tiers.intro: A verified listing answers questions before they are asked. See how yours appears in search at each level.

plain.name: Basic listing
plain.text: Only what you declare. The buyer has to take your word for it.

smartCheck.text: Show what the area is like: safety, transport, schools and prices, with sources.

physical.text: An inspector checks the home. We take the photos, the floor plan and the 360° tour.

tiers.note: Publish for free now. Order the report any time from My listings, and the badge appears automatically when it's ready.

items.a: Yes. Publishing costs nothing and we take no commission on the sale or rent.

items.q: Why do I need an account?
items.a: So that only you can edit or withdraw the listing, and messages from buyers reach you. The account takes an email and a password, in 1 minute.
Only us. The site shows the area and a circle of about 300 m.

items.q: What happens if the listing is rejected?
items.a: We tell you why, for example a photo showing documents. You fix it and resubmit from My listings.

items.q: Can I add a report later?
items.a: Yes. In My listings, tap "Order PropertyScore for this listing".
